Billionaire doomsday bunkers are somehow real, and they look very expensive.

Hi there hello.

Today we’re heading underground to look at luxury bunkers built for rich people who want to survive the apocalypse with indoor pools, fake skylights, cybertrucks, underground gardens, fish tanks, fancy garages, and all the other normal things you need when society collapses.

In this video, we take a look at luxury doomsday bunkers, billionaire survival homes, and underground apocalypse retreats that prove rich people do not want to survive the end of the world. They want to sur-thrive it.
